title: Crispy Spring Rolls with Goats Cheese
description: Delicate spring rolls filled with creamy goats cheese, served with a sweet chili sauce.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 180°C.
Prepare the spring roll filling by mixing the goats cheese, cucumber, carrot, spring onion, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Place a tablespoon of the filling in the centre of a spring roll wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little water, then fold the bottom half over the filling, followed by the sides, and finally the top half to form a triangle.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
When the oil is hot, add a few spring rolls to the pan (do not overcrowd).
Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the spring rolls from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with a sweet chili sauce for dipping.
